_comment: SAF-T tax codes used by Storno (tax type 300 = TVA). Rates are percentages; sales codes come from the 'Livrari' sheet, purchase codes from 'Achizitii ded 100%' (registered for VAT) and 'Achizitii neded' (not registered). 000/000000 is the pair ANAF prescribes for lines without any tax.
